mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_message_semantic_annotation ( message_id, content_hash, schema_version, classifier_version, status, segments_json, confidence, error_code ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{contentHash}, #{schemaVersion}, #{classifierVersion}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), schema_version = VALUES(schema_version), classifier_version = VALUES(classifier_version), status = 'PENDING', segments_json = NULL, confidence = NULL, error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE app_message_semantic_annotation SET status = 'READY', segments_json = #{segmentsJson}, confidence = #{confidence}, error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND content_hash = #{contentHash}

UPDATE app_message_semantic_annotation SET status = 'FAILED', segments_json = NULL, confidence = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND content_hash = #{contentHash}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_message_semantic_annotation WHERE status = 'READY' AND message_id IN #{id}
